title: Deepen SRD spell effect projections beyond shallow metadata
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT found all 319 spells have mechanics objects, but many are shallow metadata only: concentration/spellAttack, plus partial damage/save data.
- Codex found condition relation semantics are unsafe and many likely mechanical spells still require prose parsing.
- Fable verified spell source text and numeric fidelity are otherwise strong, with concentration flags correct except Protection from Evil and Good.

Scope examples:
- Healing, temporary HP, buffs/debuffs, resistance/immunity, condition prevention/removal/protection, recurring saves, duration/timing effects, light/visibility effects, forced movement, persistent areas, non-damage combat effects, and higher-level scaling beyond sourceText.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory spell records whose source text has deterministic gameplay effects not represented in typed mechanics.
- Split into bounded implementation child beads if needed.
- Add projections for high-impact effect categories.
- Add a gate/report distinction between "has mechanics object" and "has deterministic effect semantics."
close_reason: Implemented in PR #397 (stacked on #396): structured duration/area, 26 effect grammars, nearest-subject roll modifiers, structured per-slot/cantrip scaling, spell-depth readiness gate (212/319 deterministic, fail-closed disposition for 107 metadata-only)
